seed_commits.message:
chore: initial project scaffold

Django project, Docker setup and CI skeleton. No application code yet.
seed_commits.author: Priya Raman <priya.raman@example.com>

seed_commits.message:
feat(tenants): add Tenant model and API-key middleware

Tenants are the isolation boundary. The middleware resolves the
X-Api-Key header and stashes the tenant in a ContextVar so service
code does not have to thread it through every signature.
seed_commits.author: Priya Raman <priya.raman@example.com>

seed_commits.message:
feat(projects): add Project model

Projects are per-tenant; slugs are unique within a tenant rather than
globally so two customers can both have a project called 'website'.
seed_commits.author: Danilo Costa <danilo.costa@example.com>

seed_commits.message:
feat(billing): add LineItem and Invoice with period totals

Billing periods are inclusive at both ends. Credits are negative line
items rather than a separate table.
seed_commits.author: Danilo Costa <danilo.costa@example.com>

Adds a query-count benchmark so a regression into an N+1 is measurable rather
than a matter of opinion.
seed_commits.author: Priya Raman <priya.raman@example.com>

seed_commits.message:
perf(billing): aggregate invoice totals in SQL

compute_totals was summing line items in Python, so the memory the billing
worker needed grew with a tenant's usage to produce three numbers. Now one
aggregate query with conditional Sums.

Adds bench/bench_invoice.py, which measures rows fetched at two data sizes.
Rows rather than queries: summing a million line items in Python is one
query, so a query count cannot see this class of problem at all.
